name: Classic Margherita Pizza
description: Neapolitan-style pizza with a crisp homemade crust, tangy tomato, melting mozzarella and fragrant basil.
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, salt and warm water into a soft dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and let the dough rise for 30 minutes until doubled.
Crush the tomatoes with a pinch of salt and a drizzle of olive oil to make the sauce.
Stretch the dough into a thin round, spread the sauce and tear over the mozzarella.
Bake at the highest oven temperature for 10-12 minutes and finish with fresh basil.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
description: A quick Roman pasta of spaghetti tossed in golden garlic, olive oil and chili flakes.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in well-salted boiling water until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Gently fry the sliced garlic in olive oil until just golden, then add chili flakes.
Toss the drained spaghetti in the garlic oil with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with chopped parsley and grated parmesan.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
description: Silky arborio rice slowly cooked with mushrooms, white wine and parmesan.
instructions: Saute the onion and garlic in butter, then brown the mushrooms.
Stir in the arborio rice and toast for 1 minute; deglaze with white wine.
Add the hot broth one ladle at a time, stirring until absorbed, for about 20 minutes.
Beat in the remaining butter and parmesan, season and rest for 2 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken in a spiced, creamy tomato curry sauce.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, chili powder and salt for 20 minutes.
Sear or grill the chicken until charred at the edges; set aside.
Cook the onion, garlic and ginger in butter until soft, add the tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the remaining garam masala, the cream and the chicken; simmer 10 minutes until thick.

name: Chana Masala
description: Hearty North Indian chickpea curry simmered in a tangy, spicy onion-tomato gravy.
instructions: Heat oil, crackle the cumin seeds, then fry the onion until deep golden.
Add garlic, ginger and green chili, then the tomatoes; cook until oil separates.
Stir in garam masala and the chickpeas with a cup of water and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken, season and garnish with cilantro.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Soft paneer cubes in a vibrant, mildly spiced spinach curry.
instructions: Blanch the spinach for 2 minutes, cool in ice water and blend with the green chili.
Fry cumin, onion, garlic and ginger until soft.
Add the spinach puree and garam masala and simmer 5 minutes.
Fold in the paneer cubes and cream, heat through and serve with rice or naan.

name: Vegetable Biryani
description: Fragrant layered basmati rice with spiced vegetables, mint and ghee.
instructions: Par-boil the soaked basmati rice in salted water until 70% cooked, then drain.
Fry the sliced onions in ghee until crisp; remove half for garnish.
Cook the vegetables with yogurt, garam masala and salt for 10 minutes.
Layer the vegetables and rice in a heavy pot with mint and fried onions.
Cover tightly and cook on very low heat (dum) for 20 minutes.

name: Dal Tadka
description: Comforting yellow lentils finished with a sizzling tempering of ghee, cumin and garlic.
instructions: Pressure cook or simmer the lentils with turmeric and water until soft and creamy.
Cook the onion and tomato separately until jammy and stir into the dal.
For the tadka, heat ghee, add cumin, garlic and dried chili until sizzling.
Pour the tadka over the dal and garnish with cilantro.

name: Fresh Guacamole
description: Chunky avocado dip brightened with lime, onion, tomato and cilantro.
instructions: Halve the avocados, scoop out the flesh and mash roughly with a fork.
Fold in the onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
Season with lime juice and salt and serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Chicken Tacos
description: Smoky spiced chicken in warm corn tortillas with avocado, lime and cilantro.
instructions: Rub the chicken with chili powder, cumin, garlic, lime juice, salt and oil.
Pan-fry or grill for 6-7 minutes per side, rest, then slice thinly.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with chicken, sliced avocado, onion and cilantro; serve with lime wedges.

name: Black Bean Burrito Bowl
description: Cumin rice bowl loaded with black beans, corn, tomato salsa and avocado.
instructions: Cook the rice and stir through lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Warm the black beans with cumin, salt and a splash of water.
Make a quick salsa with tomato, onion and lime.
Assemble bowls with rice, beans, corn, salsa and sliced avocado.

name: Beef Chili con Carne
description: Rich slow-simmered beef and kidney bean chili with smoky spices.
instructions: Brown the beef in oil, breaking it up; remove excess fat.
Add onion, garlic and bell pepper and cook until soft.
Stir in chili powder and cumin, then the tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer gently for 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and rich.

name: Shrimp Pad Thai
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, egg, bean sprouts, peanuts and lime.
instructions: Soak the rice noodles in warm water until pliable; drain.
Mix tamarind, fish sauce and sugar to make the sauce.
Stir-fry garlic and shrimp in a hot wok, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles and sauce and toss until coated, then add bean sprouts and green onion.
Serve topped with crushed peanuts and lime wedges.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Aromatic coconut curry with chicken, eggplant, bell pepper and Thai basil.
instructions: Fry the green curry paste in oil until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until sealed, then pour in the coconut milk.
Add eggplant and bell pepper and simmer 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, stir in basil and serve with steamed rice.

name: Rainbow Vegetable Stir Fry
description: Crisp broccoli, carrot and bell pepper tossed in a garlic-ginger soy glaze.
instructions: Cut all vegetables into bite-sized pieces.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger in a very hot wok for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and carrot first, then bell pepper, tossing for 4-5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss and serve over rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
description: Wok-tossed day-old rice with scrambled egg, peas, carrot and green onion.
instructions: Scramble the eggs in a hot wok with a little oil, then remove.
Stir-fry garlic, carrot and peas for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and fry on high heat, breaking up clumps.
Return the egg, add soy sauce and green onion and toss well.

name: Miso Soup
description: Light, savoury Japanese broth with miso, silken tofu, seaweed and green onion.
instructions: Rehydrate the seaweed in water for 5 minutes.
Heat the water until just below boiling and add cubed tofu and seaweed.
Whisk the miso paste with a little hot broth and stir it back in; do not boil.
Serve topped with sliced green onion.

name: Teriyaki Salmon
description: Glossy honey-soy glazed salmon with ginger and sesame, served on rice.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic into a teriyaki sauce.
Sear the salmon skin-side down in oil for 4 minutes, then flip.
Pour in the sauce and simmer, basting, until sticky and glossy.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve over rice.

name: Greek Salad
description: Crunchy cucumber, tomato, olives and onion with creamy feta and oregano dressing.
instructions: Chop the cucumber and tomatoes into chunks and thinly slice the onion.
Combine in a bowl with the olives.
Top with a slab of feta, drizzle with olive oil and lemon, and sprinkle oregano.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Crisp lettuce with garlicky croutons, parmesan and a tangy anchovy dressing.
instructions: Cube the bread, toss with olive oil and garlic and toast until golden to make croutons.
Blend egg yolk, anchovy, garlic, lemon and parmesan, then stream in olive oil.
Toss torn lettuce with the dressing and top with croutons and shaved parmesan.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Simple layers of ripe tomato, fresh mozzarella and basil with balsamic.
instructions: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds.
Arrange alternately on a plate with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar and season with salt.

name: Roasted Tomato Basil Soup
description: Velvety soup of roasted tomatoes, garlic and basil finished with a swirl of cream.
instructions: Roast halved tomatoes, onion and garlic with olive oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Transfer to a pot with the vegetable broth and simmer 5 minutes.
Blend with the basil until smooth, stir in cream and season.

name: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
description: Silky autumn soup of pumpkin, coconut milk and warm nutmeg.
instructions: Soften the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the pumpkin and broth and simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
Blend until smooth with the coconut milk and nutmeg; season to taste.

name: Minestrone
description: Rustic Italian vegetable soup with beans, small pasta and tomato.
instructions: Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 8 minutes.
Add zucchini, tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the beans and pasta and cook until the pasta is tender.
Season and serve with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Classic soothing soup of chicken, egg noodles and vegetables in a herby broth.
instructions: Simmer the chicken in the broth with thyme for 20 minutes; remove and shred.
Add the chopped onion, carrot and celery and cook 10 minutes.
Add the egg noodles and cook until tender.
Return the shredded chicken, season and finish with parsley.

name: Fluffy Pancakes
description: Tall, fluffy buttermilk-style pancakes for a perfect weekend breakfast.
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk milk, egg and melted butter separately and fold into the dry mix; leave lumpy.
Cook ladlefuls on a buttered hot pan until bubbles form, flip and cook 1 more minute.
Serve stacked with maple syrup or fruit.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs gently poached in a spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce.
instructions: Cook onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft; add garlic, cumin and paprika.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Make wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until whites are set.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with bread.

name: Avocado Toast with Egg
description: Smashed avocado on crunchy toast with lemon, chili flakes and a fried egg.
instructions: Toast the bread until golden.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Fry the egg to your liking.
Spread avocado on toast, top with the egg and chili flakes.

name: Berry Overnight Oats
description: No-cook creamy oats soaked overnight with chia, banana, berries and honey.
instructions: Stir oats, milk, chia seeds and honey together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning top with sliced banana and berries.

name: Banana Smoothie
description: Thick and creamy banana smoothie with yogurt and honey.
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy and serve chilled.

name: Veggie Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette packed with spinach, bell pepper, onion and melted cheese.
instructions: Saute the onion, bell pepper and spinach in butter for 2 minutes.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook gently, lifting edges to let the egg flow.
Add cheese, fold the omelette in half and serve.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy, golden cookies studded with chocolate chips.
instructions: Cream the butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda and salt, then fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop onto a lined tray and bake at 180C for 10-12 minutes.
Cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving.

name: Chocolate Mug Cake
description: Eggless microwave chocolate cake ready in five minutes.
instructions: Mix flour, cocoa, sugar and baking powder in a large mug.
Stir in milk and oil until smooth.
Microwave on high for 70-90 seconds until risen; cool slightly.

name: Tropical Fruit Salad
description: Colourful bowl of fresh fruit tossed with honey, lime and mint.
instructions: Chop all the fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk honey with lime juice and toss through the fruit.
Garnish with torn mint and serve chilled.

name: Mango Lassi
description: Refreshing yogurt and mango drink scented with cardamom.
instructions: Peel and chop the mango.
Blend with yogurt, milk, sugar and cardamom until frothy.
Serve over ice.

name: Classic Hummus
description: Ultra-smooth chickpea dip with tahini, lemon and garlic.
instructions: Blend tahini and lemon juice for 1 minute until whipped.
Add chickpeas, garlic, cumin and salt and blend, adding ice water until silky.
Serve drizzled with olive oil.

name: Falafel Wrap
description: Crispy herby chickpea falafel wrapped in pita with tahini sauce and salad.
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley and cumin to a coarse paste; mix in flour.
Shape into small patties and fry in hot oil until deep golden.
Thin the tahini with lemon and water to make a sauce.
Fill pita with lettuce, tomato and falafel and drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Classic Beef Burger
description: Juicy grilled beef patties with melted cheese, lettuce and tomato in a soft bun.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper and shape into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-fry for 3-4 minutes per side, adding cheese for the last minute.
Toast the buns and layer with lettuce, tomato, onion and the patty.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken
description: Tender chicken marinated in lemon, garlic, rosemary and thyme, then grilled.
instructions: Whisk lemon juice and zest, garlic, chopped herbs, olive oil, salt and pepper.
Marinate the chicken for at least 15 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
description: One-tray lemon-garlic butter salmon roasted with asparagus and dill.
instructions: Arrange salmon and asparagus on a tray.
Melt butter with garlic and pour over; add lemon slices and dill.
Bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes until the salmon flakes.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
description: Macaroni in a rich cheddar cheese sauce, baked until bubbling.
instructions: Boil the macaroni until just under al dente and drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually add milk to make a smooth sauce.
Stir in most of the cheddar until melted, then the pasta.
Top with remaining cheddar and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

name: Lemony Lentil Soup
description: Hearty red lentil and vegetable soup brightened with lemon and cumin.
instructions: Saute onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add cumin, lentils, tomatoes and broth and simmer 25 minutes.
Blend partially for a creamy texture and finish with lemon juice.

name: Turmeric Tofu Scramble
description: Plant-based protein breakfast of crumbled tofu with turmeric, spinach and pepper.
instructions: Saute onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft.
Crumble in the tofu with turmeric and salt and cook 5 minutes.
Fold in spinach until wilted and serve with toast.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad
description: Protein-rich salad of quinoa, chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and parsley in lemon dressing.
instructions: Rinse and cook the quinoa for 15 minutes; cool.
Chop the cucumber, tomato and parsley.
Toss everything with chickpeas, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: Dry-spiced potato and cauliflower curry with turmeric, cumin and ginger.
instructions: Heat oil and crackle the cumin seeds; add onion and ginger and cook until golden.
Add tomato, turmeric and salt and cook to a paste.
Add potato and cauliflower florets, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes, stirring.
Sprinkle garam masala and cilantro before serving.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
description: Spaghetti tossed with juicy shrimp in a lemony garlic butter sauce.
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in salted water.
Melt butter and fry garlic and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink.
Toss with the spaghetti, lemon juice and parsley.

name: Moist Banana Bread
description: Classic loaf cake made with overripe bananas and toasted walnuts.
instructions: Mash the bananas and mix with melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour and baking soda, then the chopped walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 175C for 55-60 minutes.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers filled with seasoned beef, rice and tomato, topped with cheese.
instructions: Cut tops off the peppers and remove seeds.
Brown the beef with onion and garlic, then stir in tomato and rice.
Fill the peppers, top with cheese and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.

name: Crispy Roasted Potatoes
description: Golden, crunchy potatoes roasted with garlic, rosemary and smoked paprika.
instructions: Par-boil potato chunks for 8 minutes, drain and rough up the edges.
Toss with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, paprika and salt.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp.

name: Cheesy Vegetable Quesadilla
description: Crispy flour tortillas stuffed with melted cheese, black beans, corn and peppers.
instructions: Saute bell pepper and onion until soft; mix with beans and corn.
Scatter cheese and filling over half of each tortilla and fold.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan for 2-3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa or guacamole.
